request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for creating an Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create an Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use an Anthropic Admin API key (Platform plan) or an Analytics API key with the read:analytics scope (Enterprise plan). An invalid key, or an Analytics key without the read:analytics scope, is rejected with a 422 response.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token [required]

string

Anthropic Admin API key with permission to read usage and cost data, or an Analytics API key with the read:analytics scope. Generate an Admin API key in the Anthropic Console under Settings > Admin Keys.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from Anthropic Usage and Costs, keyed by dataflow ID. Datadog always collects usage metrics. Each dataflow in this object adds another type of collection. Set enabled to start or stop a dataflow. The default for each dataflow applies when the account is created. On update, omitted fields keep their current values. If a dataflow depends on a Datadog product, its description names that product. If you enable a dataflow without that product, Datadog stores the setting but collects no data.

anthropic-cloud-cost-metrics

object

Anthropic costs by model, workspace, and service tier, in Cloud Cost Management. Requires Cloud Cost Management on your Datadog organization. Without it, this dataflow collects no data. Cost data appears in Cloud Cost Management within 24 to 48 hours of enabling this dataflow.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false. Set to true to start collection.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating an Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update an Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account. Every field is optional. Only the provided fields are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow IDs in the request are modified. Dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use an Anthropic Admin API key (Platform plan) or an Analytics API key with the read:analytics scope (Enterprise plan). An invalid key, or an Analytics key without the read:analytics scope, is rejected with a 422 response. Only the provided fields are changed. To keep the stored token, omit token.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Anthropic Admin API key with permission to read usage and cost data, or an Analytics API key with the read:analytics scope. Generate an Admin API key in the Anthropic Console under Settings > Admin Keys.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from Anthropic Usage and Costs, keyed by dataflow ID. Datadog always collects usage metrics. Each dataflow in this object adds another type of collection. Set enabled to start or stop a dataflow. The default for each dataflow applies when the account is created. On update, omitted fields keep their current values. If a dataflow depends on a Datadog product, its description names that product. If you enable a dataflow without that product, Datadog stores the setting but collects no data.

anthropic-cloud-cost-metrics

object

Anthropic costs by model, workspace, and service tier, in Cloud Cost Management. Requires Cloud Cost Management on your Datadog organization. Without it, this dataflow collects no data. Cost data appears in Cloud Cost Management within 24 to 48 hours of enabling this dataflow.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false. Set to true to start collection.

name

string

Human-readable name of the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the Anthropic Usage and Costs integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
